text: Is it possible to file a complaint against a partner for domestic abuse  if I am no longer in Israel and back home?  I want to just forget about everything he did to me over the time but I feel like I will never feel whole again until he faces some kind of consequence and also doesn’t do it to another woman in the future. I have photos from one incident and my neighbors would be able to be witnesses I’m sure as they saw my face in the shelter after his episode.
